intro.heading: What IP-SAKTI Sahayak does
intro.what: IP-SAKTI Sahayak is a guidance portal for people developing Ayurvedic products. It helps you work out which intellectual property could protect your product, whether something similar is already on record or documented, and what to do next — with every statement about law pointing at the instrument it comes from.
intro.why: A formulation, a name or a label can be copied the day it goes on sale. Intellectual property decides whether you can stop that, and what you must do before launch to keep the option open. Some of it is lost for good by publishing too early.
intro.typesHeading: Four kinds of protection, often used together

patent.name: Patent
patent.covers: A new invention — a formulation with an effect you can show, a process, an extract. Granted for a limited term, in return for publishing it.

trademark.name: Trade mark
trademark.covers: The name, logo or other sign you sell under. Registered by class of goods, and renewable.

copyright.name: Copyright
copyright.covers: Original creative work — label artwork, packaging design, written content, software. Arises when the work is created.

tradeSecret.name: Trade secret
tradeSecret.covers: Confidential formulations, processes and know-how. Lasts as long as the secret is kept, with no registration.

helps.ingredients: List its ingredients and what is new
helps.protection: Answer a few questions on brand, creative work and confidentiality
helps.result: See what may already exist, for each kind of protection
helps.guidance: Get the recommended protection and the steps to take

need.name: The product or brand name
need.purpose: What it does, and who it is for
need.ingredients: The ingredients, and anything new in how it is made
need.materials: Whether you have packaging, artwork or software

intro.getHeading: What you get at the end
intro.get: For each kind of protection: whether anything similar was identified, what may overlap, whether it looks worth pursuing, and the steps to take through the Indian system — marked as guidance, not legal advice.

coupling.heading: उत्पादन काय आहे यावर तुम्ही काय संरक्षित करू शकता हे ठरते
coupling.standfirst: सांधेदुखीसाठीची तीच वनस्पती रचना तीन वेगळी उत्पादने असू शकते आणि प्रत्येक उत्पादन वेगवेगळे मार्ग उघडते व बंद करते. म्हणूनच सहाय्यक इतर कशाचेही उत्तर देण्यापूर्वी नियामक वर्गीकरण ठरवतो.

classical.product: एका प्रमाण ग्रंथातून जशीच्या तशी घेतलेली पारंपरिक रचना
classical.ip: घटक रचना नाही — हे दस्तऐवजीकरण केलेले पारंपरिक ज्ञान आहे. ब्रँड नाव, पॅकेजिंग आणि कलाकृती अजूनही तुमची असू शकते.
classical.abs: जैविक संसाधनाचा वापर केल्यास जबाबदाऱ्या असू शकतात, उत्पादनाची स्थिती काहीही असली तरीही.

proprietary.product: घटक किंवा डोसचे स्वरूप बदललेले मालकीचे औषध
proprietary.ip: तुम्ही प्रत्यक्षात काय बदलले यावर युक्तिवाद केला जाऊ शकतो, परंतु पारंपरिक रचना उर्वरित भागासाठी पूर्व कला म्हणून उभी राहते.
proprietary.regulatory: स्वतःच्या परवाना अटींसह पेटंट किंवा मालकीचा मार्ग.
proprietary.abs: त्याच जबाबदाऱ्या, आणि त्या आता तुम्ही दाखल करत असलेल्या कोणत्याही गोष्टीशी संबंधित असतात.

newDrug.product: नवीन गैर-पारंपरिक औषध, किंवा प्रमाणित अर्क
newDrug.ip: सर्वात जास्त वाव — शुद्ध केलेला घटक किंवा नवीन प्रक्रियेवर स्वतःच्या गुणवत्तेनुसार दावा केला जाऊ शकतो.
newDrug.regulatory: नवीन औषध मार्ग, जो ग्रंथांऐवजी पुराव्यांची मागणी करतो.
newDrug.abs: कर्तव्ये लागू होतात आणि जैविक स्रोताचा खुलासा करणे अर्जाचा भाग बनते.

coupling.note: हे सामान्य स्वरूप आहे. तपशील स्रोतांसह जोडलेल्या उत्तरात असतो, मुख्यपृष्ठावर नाही.

covers.heading: एकाच उत्पादनाबद्दल विचारले जाणारे दोन प्रश्न
covers.ipQuestion: मी यातील हक्क कसे सुरक्षित करू किंवा समजू?
covers.regQuestion: हे विकण्यापूर्वी मला काय करणे आवश्यक आहे?
covers.band: सीमा ओलांडून, भारतीय उत्तर आणि निर्यात उत्तर वेगवेगळ्या स्रोतांतून स्वतंत्रपणे तयार केले जाते आणि कधीही एका परिच्छेदात एकत्र केले जात नाही.

answer.heading: उत्तर कसे दिसते
answer.standfirst: प्रत्येक दावा त्याच्या मागे असलेल्या उताऱ्याकडे निर्देश करतो. कोणताही स्रोत नसलेली वाक्ये तशी चिन्हांकित केली आहेत. अधिकारक्षेत्र बदलल्याने उत्तर बदलते, ते रुंदावत नाही.
answer.question: आम्ही एका पारंपरिक पॉलीहर्बल रचनेत बदल केले आहेत आणि ते भारत व युकेमध्ये विकू इच्छितो. आम्ही प्रथम काय ठरवावे?

languages.heading: तुम्ही काम करता त्या भाषेत विचारा
languages.standfirst: तुम्ही टाइप करता त्यावरून भाषा ओळखली जाते; तुम्ही ती बदलू शकता. उत्तरे त्याच भाषेत येतात आणि मूळ दस्तऐवज ज्या भाषेत प्रकाशित झाले होते त्याच भाषेत राहतात.
languages.note: भाषांतर थर इंटरफेसच्या मागे असतो, त्यामुळे भाषिणीसारख्या राष्ट्रीय भाषा पायाभूत सुविधांद्वारे ही सेवा दिली जाऊ शकते. मूळ उतारे कधीही भाषांतरित केले जात नाहीत — भाषांतरित संदर्भ हा संदर्भ राहत नाही.

samples.en: Can we register our brand name if it contains a classical formulation name?
samples.hi: हमारे ब्रांड नाम को कैसे सुरक्षित कर सकते हैं?
samples.te: మా ఆయుర్వేద ఉత్పత్తులను ఎగుమతి చేయాలంటే ఏమి కావాలి?
samples.bn: আমাদের পণ্যের লেবেলে কী লেখা যাবে?
samples.mr: आमचे उत्पादन औषध आहे की अन्न?

closing.heading: हे काय करणार नाही
closing.body: अर्ज मंजूर होईल की नाही हे सांगणार नाही, मसुदा तयार करणार नाही किंवा वैद्यकीय सल्ला देणार नाही. हे प्रकाशित स्रोतांच्या निश्चित संचातून उत्तरे देते, त्यामुळे कक्षेबाहेरील प्रश्नाचे उत्तर मिळत नाही.

patentSteps.heading: Steps to get a patent
patentSteps.standfirst: The route an application takes in India, in order, and what Sahayak does for you at each step. Every step names the instrument that governs it — open one to see the citation and the forms it involves.
patentSteps.aria: Steps to get a patent, in order
patentSteps.expand: Show the source for this step
patentSteps.collapse: Hide the source for this step
patentSteps.notRetrieved: Named for reference. Ask Sahayak for a cited answer on any of these.

handoff.priorArt: Turns a description of your formulation into search terms, lists the patent registries to search, and explains who can search the TKDL. It never tells you something is new.
handoff.classify: Works out what your product is, regulatorily, in a few yes-or-no questions. That decides how much of the formulation can realistically be claimed.
handoff.ask: Sends this step's question to Sahayak. You get an answer with every claim cited, or the reason it cannot answer from its sources.

questions.disclosure: What prior art should we search before filing a patent for our Ayurvedic formulation, including traditional knowledge?
questions.patentability: Which exclusions in section 3 of the Patents Act apply to a herbal formulation?
questions.drafting: What is the difference between a provisional and a complete patent specification?
questions.filing: Which forms are needed to file a patent application in India?
questions.complete: When must a complete specification be filed after a provisional patent application?
questions.publication: When is a patent application published, and can it be published early?
questions.examination: How do I request examination of a patent application?
questions.fer: How do I respond to a first examination report on a patent application?
questions.hearing: What happens at a patent hearing before the Controller?
questions.grant: When is a patent granted, and where is the grant published?

forms.form26: Form 26 — authorisation of a patent agent

disclosure.title: Disclosure and prior-art search
disclosure.body: Record the invention and search what is already known. For an Ayurvedic formulation this includes traditional-knowledge sources such as the TKDL, because documented traditional knowledge stands as prior art.

patentability.title: Patentability check
patentability.body: Work out whether the subject matter falls within the exclusions from patentability — in particular those covering new forms of known substances, mere admixtures, and traditional knowledge or aggregations of known properties.

drafting.title: Draft the specification
drafting.body: Prepare either a provisional specification, which secures a filing date while the work continues, or a complete specification with claims.

filing.title: File at the Patent Office
filing.body: File the application with its accompanying forms at the appropriate patent office. An application filed through a patent agent carries an authorisation form as well.

complete.title: Complete specification after a provisional
complete.body: Where a provisional was filed first, the complete specification follows within the period the Act allows, or the application is treated as abandoned.

publication.title: Publication
publication.body: Applications are published after the period set out in the Act. Publication can be brought forward on request rather than waiting for the ordinary date.

examination.title: Request for examination
examination.body: Examination is not automatic — it happens on request, made within the prescribed window. An application not requested for examination in time is treated as withdrawn.

fer.title: First Examination Report
fer.body: The examiner reports objections. The applicant answers them, and puts the application in order for grant, within the period the Rules prescribe.

hearing.title: Hearing
hearing.body: Where objections remain outstanding after the reply, the Controller may offer a hearing before deciding.

grant.title: Grant and publication
grant.body: An application found in order proceeds to grant, and the grant is published in the official journal.

opposition.title: Opposition
opposition.body: The Act provides two routes: an opposition before grant, and an opposition after grant within the period it allows. They run on different grounds and different timetables.

renewal.title: Renewal and term
renewal.body: A granted patent is kept in force by renewal fees from the third year. The term runs twenty years from the date of filing.
